rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for referring indirectly or hinting at something without saying it outright.

example.english: They allude to not wanting to take part by staying quiet all evening.
example.traditional: 佢成晚都唔出聲，其實係暗示唔想參加。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 maan5 dou1 m4 ceot1 seng1 kei4 sat6 hai6 am3 si6 m4 soeng2 caam1 gaa1

rows.note: Use this when the indirect reference is pointed or veiled, often aimed at a person or criticized target.

example.english: You don't need to allude to my being late anymore; I know who you're talking about.
example.traditional: 你唔使再影射我遲到，我知你講緊邊個。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 zoi3 jing2 se6 ngo5 ci4 dou3 ngo5 zi1 nei5 gong2 gan2 bin1 go3
